statement: Assume RH and the cited Bui–Florea–Heycock and Bui–Florea reciprocal estimates. With U=log x, φ(U)=sqrt(U/log U), and M_x(it)=Σ_{n≤x}μ(n)n^(−it), uniformly for |t|≤x^(3/4), |ζ(1/2+it) M_x(it)| ≪ sqrt(x){|ζ(1/2+it)|exp(C*φ(U))+(1+|t|)^(1/2)exp(D*sqrt(U)/log U)}.
verification: Proposed twisted Perron bound isolates a variable-shift local panel; published reciprocal estimate checked by primary-source reading.

statement: Assume RH, the BFH Mertens estimate with exponent C, and the cited reciprocal moment and pointwise estimates. For any fixed A>C, ε_N=A/sqrt(log N log log N) and P_N=Σ_{n≤N}μ(n)n^(−s−ε_N), the classical normalized error satisfies d_1(P_N)=O((log N log log N)^(-1/4)).
verification: Twisted bound plus low-height Plancherel, intermediate-height estimates and Balazard–de Roton Proposition 13. No comparison between contour constant C* and Mertens exponent C is used.
